page.content:
Vessel of the Last Supper or Joseph of Arimathea's relic.

How Holy Grail connects

  • Event: Grail Quest — The Grail Quest is the search for the Holy Grail.
  • Location: Corbenic — The Grail is kept at Corbenic until the chosen knights arrive.

What is Holy Grail?

The Holy Grail enters Arthurian story from French spiritual romance: a dish or cup that feeds, heals, and judges. Only Galahad, Perceval, and Bors see it fully.

Key threads lead to Grail Quest and Corbenic.
